description: Get the full details of a single Microsoft To Do task by its list ID and task ID, including title, status, importance, full body/notes, due date, reminder time, created/completed times, and any checklist (sub-task) items. Use after list_tasks or find_due_tasks to read a to-do item in full.

list_id.description: The ID of the Microsoft To Do task list containing the task.

task_id.description: The ID of the task to retrieve (from a list or find result).

name: get_task
title: Get Task
